codeReview.summary: The implementation fully matches the feature scope. The only code change is in `Win32Window.extractIMECompositionString`, where the deprecated `String(decodingCString:as:)` call was replaced with `String(decoding: buffer.prefix(charCount), as: UTF16.self)`. Because `charCount` is derived from the exact byte count returned by `ImmGetCompositionStringW`, the new decode consumes the same UTF-16 payload without depending on a trailing NUL sentinel, so it removes the warning without introducing an unexpected behavior change in the IME composition path.
